Five official SDKs. Python, TypeScript, Java, PHP and Ruby, each published to its language's package registry and generated from the same OpenAPI spec that produces this API reference.

The Create Registration API allows users to create a new registration for tracking and managing tax filings efficiently across multiple jurisdictions.
The Get Filings API retrieves a paginated list of filings based on filters such as dates, jurisdiction, Country, status, etc.
The Create Exemption API allows you to create a new exemption record. This includes defining details such as exemption type, jurisdiction, Country, State, validity dates, etc.
